name: Our Timing in a Minor Key
original_name: Our Timing in a Minor Key
overview: The story follows two individuals who meet at the wrong time and place, ultimately finding self-understanding and a deep connection. The narrative centers on Jan, a cozy bar owner who completely shuts down her heart following a devastating breakup. The central theme revolves around two wounded people crossing paths at a chaotic, imperfect moment in their lives. Through this unexpected connection, they find a deep mutual understanding and begin to heal.
